PhyloGNN Documentation¶

PhyloGNN is a Python package for turning phylogenetic trees into PyTorch Geometric graph data and training graph neural network models on those graphs. It is intended for users who already have tree data and want a practical path from tree input to graph conversion, feature engineering, training, metrics, and reference lookup.

Fastest path¶

  1. Install the core package or the optional extra needed by your workflow.

  2. Follow the quickstart to create a graph from a small Newick tree.

  3. Use the graph data concept page to interpret x, edge_index, and metadata fields.

  4. Move to the workflow guides for feature engineering, training, and optional tracking or tree file support.
